summary: Restoration is addressed through an EU-wide goal to place restoration measures in at least 20% of EU land and sea areas by 2030, and in all ecosystems needing restoration by 2050. For perspective, Spain currently has 33.3% forest, 6.5% grassland, 0.1% wetland and 51.2% agricultural cover, although the 20% pledge is not stated as a Spain-specific area target. Conservation focuses on LULUCF: a collective EU 2030 target of 310 Mt CO2-eq in net removals (also stated as a -310 Mt CO2-eq carbon-sink target), 42 Mt more removals than the 2016–2018 average, and Spain’s listed 2030 national target of -5,309 Kt CO2eq. Agriculture commitments are funding-based: 40% of the EU Common Agricultural Policy allocation for 2023–2027 should support climate objectives, with at least 25% of annual direct-payment funds earmarked for eco-schemes and 35% of Pillar II funds dedicated to environment and climate activities.
